verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented docs are a fair question for an MCP registry and platform like Smithery, so the axis applies. However, probes found no llms.txt (404) and no docs.md (404). No evidence in the pack shows Smithery publishing agent-oriented documentation for its own product. Listing third-party servers such as Context7 in its registry is a different capability and does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
